name: Four sword combat attack toward enemy to RIGHT, then recover

They are rigid visible blades, NOT stationary sparkles, NOT disappearing. All FOUR blades contribute to the strike. Clear anticipation, explosive contact, low follow-through, recover original stance. Full articulated combat movement with bent knees, hip twist, elbow and wrist arcs; not image translation or stretching. Preserve her identity, outfit and exactly four colored swords. Transparent, fixed camera, no added enemy.
